learn.due.note: Facts due for review today (spaced repetition)

learn.intro.one: Practice brings back what is due, then what you have not met. A fact counts as known once you recall it {count} day apart; an exam of {size} mixed questions at {mark} proves a chapter.
learn.intro.other: Practice brings back what is due, then what you have not met. A fact counts as known once you recall it {count} days apart; an exam of {size} mixed questions at {mark} proves a chapter.
learn.intro.note: {mark} is the pass mark as a percentage, e.g. '80%'

learn.show_text_only.one: Show {count} chapter with Hebrew and KJV only
learn.show_text_only.other: Show {count} chapters with Hebrew and KJV only
learn.show_text_only.note: Button: also list chapters that have only the source text and the King James Version, no story yet

learn.family.story.note: Question family: who did what, and why

learn.family.time_place.note: Question family: when, how long, and where

learn.family.hebrew.note: Question family: Hebrew words and verse text

learn.kind.scene.note: Question kind: which scene a detail belongs to

learn.kind.cause.note: Question kind: what caused an event

learn.kind.state.note: Question kind: a person's or thing's state at a moment

learn.kind.order.note: Question kind: put scenes in order

learn.kind.where.note: Question kind: click on the map where it happened

learn.kind.place.note: Question kind: where something happened, chosen from a list

learn.kind.span.note: Question kind: how much time passed between two scenes

learn.kind.age.note: Question kind: how old someone was

learn.kind.gloss.note: Question kind: what a Hebrew word means

learn.kind.word.note: Question kind: which Hebrew word is used

learn.kind.cloze.note: Question kind: fill the gap in a verse

learn.mode.practice.note: Learning mode, beside the chapter name

learn.mode.exam.note: Learning mode, beside the chapter name

learn.mode.retell.note: Learning mode: retell the chapter from memory

learn.answer.in_unit.note: Placeholder of a number answer field: 'in days'

learn.answer.word.note: Placeholder of a text answer field

learn.check.note: Button: submit the answer; the Enter key symbol follows

learn.feedback.close.note: Feedback on a partly correct answer; {score} is a percentage

learn.feedback.read.note: Link to read the verse in the Codex; {ref} is chapter:verse such as '38:4'

learn.feedback.next_in.note: When the question comes back (spaced repetition); 'd' abbreviates days

learn.feedback.again_soon.note: The question comes back in ten minutes

learn.next.note: Button: next question; the Enter key symbol follows

learn.quiz.note: Heading of an error notice in the quiz

learn.nothing.title: Nothing to ask
learn.nothing.text: This chapter has no material for these kinds yet.

learn.result.round.note: Panel title after a practice round

learn.result.not_yet.note: Under the exam score when the exam is not passed

learn.result.score.note: Under the score of a practice round

learn.result.proven.note: {chapter} is a chapter reference such as GEN.37

learn.result.try_again.text: {mark} proves a chapter. Practise the misses and try again.
learn.result.try_again.note: {mark} is the pass mark as a percentage

learn.of.note: After a score: out of how many questions or points

learn.chapters.note: Back link to the list of chapters; an arrow precedes it

learn.retell.title.note: {chapter} is a chapter reference such as GEN.37

learn.retell.words.note: Length of the retelling typed so far

learn.retell.intro: From memory: who, what, where, in what order. Claude checks it against the chapter's events (about a minute).

learn.retell.placeholder.text: Joseph, seventeen, was shepherding with his brothers…
learn.retell.placeholder.note: Example opening of a retelling of Genesis 37, shown in the empty text box

learn.retell.busy.note: Button while the retelling is being graded

learn.retell.check.note: Button: send the retelling to be graded

learn.retell.feedback.note: Panel title: the grade of a retelling

learn.retell.order: The order of the scenes differs from the text.

learn.retell.check_label.note: Label of a claim in the retelling that needs checking

learn.retell.error.note: A claim quoted from the retelling, then its correction; use the language's quotation marks

learn.retell.told.note: Column heading: scenes the retelling covered

learn.retell.missed.note: Column heading: scenes the retelling left out

learn.card.proven.note: Tooltip of the star on a proven chapter

learn.card.due.note: Facts of this chapter due for review

learn.card.known.note: Facts known out of the chapter's facts

learn.card.retell.note: Button: retell the chapter from memory
